proposed_statement_changes.proposed: Suppose \(n\ge2\). Under the two-scale geometric restriction \(q<\gamma\), \(a\asymp\ell^\alpha\), \(b\asymp\ell^\beta\), \(ab\asymp\delta\), \(h\asymp\delta^{1/\gamma}\), and \(\ell\asymp\delta^{1/q}\), sparse occupancy gives \(kp_2\asymp n^2h^d\ell^d\). Thus the two exponents in Theorem 2 are bounded below by fixed positive constants when \(\delta\ge C\max\{r_{\mathrm{pair}},r_F\}\), and can be made arbitrarily large by increasing \(C\). This is a fixed-error pure-private separation guarantee, restricted to \(q<\gamma\) and \(nv\le c_0\), at the named coupled radius \(r_F=(n^2\epsilon)^{-1/D_F}\), without a nuisance-sign logarithm. For \(k=1\) and nuisance profile \(\lambda=(\lambda_1)\in\{-1,1\}\), let \(O_i=(Y_i,A_i,X_i)\), \(i\in\{1,2\}\), be independent records from \(P_{s,(\lambda_1)}\), and set \(U_i=2A_i-1\), \(V_i=2Y_i-1\), and \(Z_{12}=(U_1V_2+V_1U_2)/2\). Then the sanity reduction is \[\mathbb E_{P_{s,(\lambda_1)}^{\otimes2}}\!\left[Z_{12}\,\middle|\,X_1,X_2\in C_1\right]=4sab.\]
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The current claim quantifies over \(n\in\mathbb N\), but at \(n=1\) one has \(p_2=0\), so \(kp_2\asymp n^2h^d\ell^d>0\) is false. The pair construction and its cited testing theorem already operate only for \(n\ge2\); adding exactly that boundary condition makes the occupancy comparison valid without changing the model class or substantive rate regime.

open_obligations.what_is_open: A uniform construction, at the same sample size \(n\), of one-sensitive composite scores \(\{Q_t:t\in\mathcal G_r\}\) whose weighted shell functional is bounded independently of the nuisance-sieve cardinality for every \(r\ge C\max\{R_n^{\mathrm{NP}},r_G,r_F\}\).
open_obligations.obstruction: The proved pair score cancels the nuisance signs only for the explicit shared-sign least-favorable family. For arbitrary least-favorable priors over the full Hölder fibers, the frozen primitives supply neither a decomposition of the sample-level likelihood into localized second-order blocks nor a bound showing that Hamming stabilization costs only \(r_G\) and \(r_F\). Scalar nonprivate minimax absolute risk controls ordinary threshold error but does not imply the summable score-margin tails required by \(\mathfrak W_r\), and sample splitting would change \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\) to a different-sample comparator.
open_obligations.attempted: The finite profiled-threshold route, occupancy-normalized Hoeffding projection, and scalar-shell exponential aggregation were checked. The last aggregation is proved once the certificate holds, and the shared-sign component has the desired log-free certificate, but extending its sign cancellation to arbitrary dependent nuisance mixtures leaves an uncontrolled higher-order remainder or a nuisance-net union bound. No valid argument from the unspecified value of \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\) removes that remainder at the same \(n\).
